title: Money alone will not scale your ads
description: Money alone will not scale your ads
transcript: Any any advertising campaign that is able to scale to let's say over $5,000 a day and spend they have some kind of testing system inside of there. It's not even a question. Um, I think you could get to $1,000 a day to $2,000 a day and spend just by kind of messing around some by thinking oh, oh, this ad's starting to not perform well. Let me put some time on my calendar shoot it uploaded blah blah blah but if you're really trying to scale this bad boy, especially if you don't want to be the one in charge of everything if you have a marketing team, marketing director, a media buyer, an agency, then you want to build some kind of testing framework in for being able to add new ad creatives and essentially feeding the beasts you the the advertising machine it it accepts both money and ad creatives so you can't just spend money you have to give it uh money and ad creatives in order to be able to scale.
